modmenu.descriptionTranslation.leawind_t.en: A practical, smooth, feature-rich third-person mod.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.leawind_t.zh: 一个实用、丝滑、功能丰富的第三人称模组

leawind_third_person.text.description.en: A practical, smooth, feature-rich third-person mod.
leawind_third_person.text.description.zh: 一个实用、丝滑、功能丰富的第三人称模组

leawind_third_person.button.sync_to_aimi.en: Synchronize the settings from aiming mode。
leawind_third_person.button.sync_to_aimi.zh: 将瞄准模式的设置同步到此处

leawind_third_person.button.sync_to_norm.en: Synchronize the settings from normal mode。
leawind_third_person.button.sync_to_norm.zh: 将正常模式的设置同步到此处

leawind_third_person.option_category.cam.zh: 调整玩家在屏幕上的位置等参数。

leawind_third_person.option_category.ite.en: Item predicates to match items. Reference to https://leawind.github.io/Third-Person/en-US/?search=Item+Predicate
leawind_third_person.option_category.ite.zh: 用于匹配物品的物品谓词，参考 https://leawind.github.io/Third-Person/zh-CN/Details/#物品谓词

leawind_third_person.option_group.camera.en: Adjust the camera-to-player distance factor using the mouse wheel when holding specific keys in third-person mode. This setting determines the adjustment range.
leawind_third_person.option_group.camera.zh: 第三人称下按住特定按键时可以用滚轮调整相机到玩家的距离系数。此处可以设置距离的调节范围。

leawind_third_person.option_group.aiming.en: When aiming with bow, crossbow, trident, etc.
leawind_third_person.option_group.aiming.zh: 当使用弓|弩|戟等瞄准时。

leawind_third_person.option_group.player.en: Fade out the player in tight spaces to avoid obstructing the view.
leawind_third_person.option_group.player.zh: 狭小空间内让玩家淡出，避免遮挡视线。

leawind_third_person.option_group.adjust.en: By default, holding Z allows you to use the mouse to adjust the camera's offset and distance.
leawind_third_person.option_group.adjust.zh: 默认按住Z可以用鼠标调节相机的偏移量和远近。

leawind_third_person.option_group.behavi.en: How the player rotates when pressing the interact key (attack|use|select).
leawind_third_person.option_group.behavi.zh: 当按下交互键（攻击|使用|选取）时，玩家如何转动。

leawind_third_person.option.is_mod_enabl.en: Disabling this will show the original third-person perspective, but you can still open the configuration screen with a key.
leawind_third_person.option.is_mod_enabl.zh: 禁用后将显示原版第三人称视角，但仍可以按键打开配置屏幕。

leawind_third_person.option.center_offse.en: When the entity the camera is attached to is flying with elytra, do not use camera offset.
leawind_third_person.option.center_offse.zh: 当相机附着的实体正在使用鞘翅飞行时，不使用相机偏移量。

leawind_third_person.option.temp_first_p.zh: 狭窄空间暂时第一人称

leawind_third_person.option.temp_first_p.en: Temporarily enter first person while player is in narrow space.
leawind_third_person.option.temp_first_p.zh: 当玩家处于狭窄空间中时，暂时进入第一人称。

leawind_third_person.option.player_fade_.en: When player blocks the sight, make the player semi-transparent.
leawind_third_person.option.player_fade_.zh: 当玩家实体阻挡视野时，让其变得半透明。

leawind_third_person.option.gaze_opacity.en: When crosshair on entity, set entity opacity to this value.
leawind_third_person.option.gaze_opacity.zh: 当准星放在相机实体上时，将相机实体的不透明度降低到这个值。

leawind_third_person.option.player_invis.en: When camera is close enough, player becomes invisible.
leawind_third_person.option.player_invis.zh: 当相机离玩家足够近时，玩家变得不可见。

leawind_third_person.option.use_camera_p.en: Use camera pick in creative mode
In creative mode, the player's line of sight will not be obstructed, and the crosshair indicates the interaction point.
leawind_third_person.option.use_camera_p.zh: 创造模式下玩家视线不会被遮挡，准星指哪就交互哪。

leawind_third_person.option.lock_camera_.en: After locking, it is impossible to rotate up and down.

leawind_third_person.option.auto_turn_bo.en: Automatically turn sideways when drawing a bow
Automatically turn sideways when drawing a bow, with the hand holding the bow in front and the hand pulling the string behind.
leawind_third_person.option.auto_turn_bo.zh: 拉弓时自动侧身，让持弓的手在前，拉弦的手在后。

leawind_third_person.option.render_cross.zh: 在瞄准状态下显示准星。
在未瞄准状态下显示准星。

leawind_third_person.option.available_di.en: Use the mouse wheel to adjust the camera-to-player distance. This option represents the number of distance levels.
leawind_third_person.option.available_di.zh: 使用鼠标滚轮可以调整相机到玩家距离，该选项的值是距离的档位数量。

leawind_third_person.option.camera_dista.en: The minimum distance factor from the player when adjusting with the mouse wheel.
leawind_third_person.option.camera_dista.zh: 使用滚轮调整时相机到玩家的最小距离系数。

leawind_third_person.option.camera_dista.en: The maximum distance from the player when adjusting with the mouse wheel.
leawind_third_person.option.camera_dista.zh: 使用滚轮调整时相机到玩家的最大距离系数。

leawind_third_person.option.flying_smoot.en: Smoothness for camera following player during flight
leawind_third_person.option.flying_smoot.zh: 飞行时相机跟随玩家的平滑系数

leawind_third_person.option.t2f_transiti.en: Smoothness when transition from third-person to first-person.
leawind_third_person.option.t2f_transiti.zh: 从第三人称平滑过渡到第一人称时的平滑系数。

leawind_third_person.option.adjusting_ca.zh: 调整相机偏移量的平滑系数

leawind_third_person.option.adjusting_ca.en: Smoothness for changes in camera offset as the mouse moves while adjusting the camera.
leawind_third_person.option.adjusting_ca.zh: 调整相机时，相机偏移量随鼠标移动而变化的平滑系数。

leawind_third_person.option.adjusting_di.zh: 调整相机距离的平滑系数

leawind_third_person.option.adjusting_di.en: Smoothness for changes in camera-to-player distance when adjusting the camera.
leawind_third_person.option.adjusting_di.zh: 调整相机距离时，相机到玩家距离变化的平滑系数。

leawind_third_person.option.distance_smo.en: Time for the camera to move away from the player.

leawind_third_person.option.aiming_fov_d.en: FOV zoom factor when aiming. The distance between the camera and the player will also change accordingly.
leawind_third_person.option.aiming_fov_d.zh: 瞄准时视野范围（FOV）缩放倍率，相机与玩家间的距离会随之变化。

leawind_third_person.option.max_distance.zh: 相机到玩家的最大距离系数

leawind_third_person.option.is_centered..en: Whether the player is in the center of the screen.
leawind_third_person.option.is_centered..zh: 玩家是否位于屏幕中央。

leawind_third_person.option.offset_cente.en: Long-pressing specific keys can center the view. When centered, the X offset is fixed at 0, and the player is in the middle of the screen. This option adjusts the Y offset at this time.
leawind_third_person.option.offset_cente.zh: 长按特定按键可以居中，居中状态下X偏移固定为0，玩家处于屏幕中间。本选项可以调整此时的Y偏移。

leawind_third_person.option.camera_ray_t.en: When the targeted object exceeds this distance while aiming, the player's line of sight will be parallel to the camera's line of sight.
leawind_third_person.option.camera_ray_t.zh: 当瞄准的物体超过这个距离时，玩家视线会和相机视线平行。

leawind_third_person.option.camera_dista.en: You will find the difference when adjusting the camera offset.
leawind_third_person.option.camera_dista.zh: 你将在调整相机偏移量时发现区别。

leawind_third_person.option.rotate_cente.zh: 将相机的旋转中心上下偏移一段距离

leawind_third_person.option.enable_targe.en: Enable target entity prediction when aiming
leawind_third_person.option.enable_targe.zh: 瞄准时启用目标实体预测

leawind_third_person.option.enable_targe.en: When aiming, predict the target entity you want to shoot, calculate the player's rotation based on this, for better aiming at the target.
leawind_third_person.option.enable_targe.zh: 瞄准时，自动预测想要射击的目标实体，据此计算玩家朝向，以便更好地瞄准目标。

leawind_third_person.option.skip_vanilla.en: Only first-person and third-person perspectives are retained
leawind_third_person.option.skip_vanilla.zh: 仅保留第一人称和第三人称视角

leawind_third_person.option.disable_thir.zh: 禁用第三人称视角摇晃

leawind_third_person.option.disable_thir.en: In third person, disable view bobbing
leawind_third_person.option.disable_thir.zh: 第三人称下禁用视角摇晃

leawind_third_person.option.allow_double.en: In third person mode, allow the vanilla double-tap sprinting feature
leawind_third_person.option.allow_double.zh: 第三人称下允许原版的双击方向键疾跑功能

leawind_third_person.option.auto_rotate_.en: When pressing the interact key (attack|use|select), the player will automatically rotate.
leawind_third_person.option.auto_rotate_.zh: 当按下交互键（攻击|使用|选取）时，玩家会自动转身。

leawind_third_person.option.determine_ai.zh: 通过动画判断瞄准模式

leawind_third_person.option.determine_ai.en: When specific animation is played, automatically enter aiming mode.
leawind_third_person.option.determine_ai.zh: 当相机实体播放特定动画时，自动进入瞄准模式。

leawind_third_person.option.hold_to_aim_.en: When the player's left or right hand is holding an item that matches any rule, automatically enter aiming mode.
leawind_third_person.option.hold_to_aim_.zh: 当玩家左手或右手拿着的物品符合任意一条规则时，自动进入瞄准模式。

leawind_third_person.option.use_to_aim_i.en: When the item the player is using matches any rule, automatically enter aiming mode.
leawind_third_person.option.use_to_aim_i.zh: 当玩家正在使用的物品符合任意一条规则时，自动进入瞄准模式。

leawind_third_person.option.use_to_first.en: Temporarily enter first person when used
leawind_third_person.option.use_to_first.zh: 使用时暂时进入第一人称

leawind_third_person.option.use_to_first.en: When the item the player is using matches any rule, temporarily enter first-person view.
leawind_third_person.option.use_to_first.zh: 当玩家正在使用的物品符合任意一条规则时，暂时进入第一人称视角。

key.leawind_third_person.toggle_side.en: Toggle camera to the other side

key.leawind_third_person.toggle_aiming.en: Short press to toggle aiming state
